name: Prohibited-use and disclosure policy control registry
disclaimer: Categories below are engineering screening categories derived from reported TRAIGA prohibited-use topics. They are screening prompts for a human reviewer, not legal determinations. A registration blocked by one of these controls is escalated to the district AI Risk Officer and counsel, not silently refused.

controls.screening_question: Does this use case aim to influence a person toward self-harm, harm to others, or criminal activity?
Does this use case generate content intended to incite violence or unlawful action?
Does this use case assign a person a score or rating used to determine access to services, benefits, or opportunities based on aggregated behaviour?
controls.notes: Watch for well-intentioned district variants: composite 'student risk scores' assembled from attendance, discipline, and behaviour data can fall squarely in this category.

controls.screening_question: Does this use case capture, derive, or match biometric identifiers (face, voice, gait, fingerprint) without consent?
controls.notes: Campus safety and visitor-management vendors frequently include this capability by default. Screening applies to procured systems, not only to systems the district builds.

controls.screening_question: Could this use case restrict speech, association, religious exercise, or due process?
Could this use case produce disparate outcomes across a protected class?
controls.required_evidence: Bias evaluation results disaggregated by affected group, plus documented human review of consequential outputs.

controls.screening_question: Could this use case produce or process sexually explicit material involving minors, or non-consensual explicit depictions?
controls.notes: Also implemented as an output-validation control, not only a registration screen, because a general-purpose assistant can be steered toward this regardless of registered purpose.

controls.screening_question: Will a student, parent, or member of the public interact with this system?
controls.required_evidence: Configured disclosure string and a transcript or screenshot showing it presented before interaction.
